products.name: RAPP AI Dyno
products.summary: Understand what your AI work costs before choosing where to spend the next credit.
products.deliverable: A local Python CLI and desktop prototype for quota readings, work history, and model-routing plans.
products.limitations: Model quality certification and customer-ready packaging remain pending. Historical benchmark samples are not a guarantee of savings.
products.platforms: Python CLI; desktop and fresh-machine qualification pending.
products.license_note: Customer distribution terms have not been published.

products.name: Raptr Finisher
products.summary: Find the overlooked value in unfinished AI work and give it a path toward a real product.
products.deliverable: A local Python metadata crawler and template-based product-manifest generator.
products.limitations: Autonomous value discovery, code extraction, customer-release verification, and continuous operation are not yet implemented. Generated ideas are not finished products.
products.platforms: Python CLI prototype; fresh-machine qualification pending.
products.license_note: Customer distribution terms have not been published.

products.name: RAPP Work
products.summary: A librarian for your AI work: find a past session without moving everything into another workspace.
products.deliverable: Research-stage recall scripts and pointer-indexing experiments.
products.limitations: A supported multi-tool product, voice workflow, customer installer, and license still need qualification.
products.platforms: Python research tooling; supported customer platforms pending.
products.license_note: Customer distribution terms have not been published.

products.name: RAPP Flight Recorder
products.summary: Make agent work easier to inspect with redacted records and explicit capability checks.
products.deliverable: Recorder and conformance components within an existing agent-wrapper codebase.
products.limitations: This is not a standalone compliance product or regulatory certification. Component packaging, license review, and supported installation remain pending.
products.platforms: Python and TypeScript components; standalone platform qualification pending.
products.license_note: Upstream license notices exist; extracted-product terms remain pending.

products.name: Brainstem Organ Packs
products.summary: Add useful capabilities around Brainstem without replacing its core.
products.deliverable: Desktop integration and optional-capability work from an existing Brainstem wrapper.
products.limitations: Paid packs, signed distribution, entitlements, and customer license terms are not released.
products.platforms: Desktop integration tooling; pack-specific supported platforms pending.
products.license_note: Customer distribution and upstream licensing review remain pending.

products.name: RAPP Verified Atlas
products.summary: Research with sources you can inspect, not just an answer you have to trust.
products.deliverable: Research drivers, question datasets, and historical citation-checking experiments.
products.limitations: Independent accuracy validation, supported analyst workflows, and a customer-facing release remain pending. No guarantee of zero hallucinations is offered.
products.platforms: Python research tooling; customer platform qualification pending.
products.license_note: Customer distribution terms have not been published.

products.name: RAPP Stream Shield
products.summary: A focused privacy layer for people who demonstrate AI work in public.

products.platforms: Standalone supported platforms are not yet defined.
products.license_note: Component reuse and customer distribution terms remain pending.
